Hope you’re well — quick ask from Luminary. We were approved for the standard mini-grant (USD 12,000 in free credits) but we’ve had a last-minute opportunity to run a paid pilot / demo at DemoWeek in two weeks. Cashflow for the demo is tight and the demo requires short-lived dedicated capacity and extra tokens for synthetic load tests.

Is there any way Redwood can: 1) allow an early draw of 50% of the mini-grant credits now (we’d use them for staging + demo); and 2) temporarily convert 100k tokens of the free credits into a 48-hour dedicated capacity window (we’ll revert to hosted after the event)?

We’re happy to sign a short usage covenant (commit to a modest post-demo evaluation window) and provide an invoice/PO if that helps. I attached a one-page request and a usage projection (xlsx).

This is a one-off — the demo drives introductions to a few late-stage enterprise prospects for us. Appreciate any flexibility.

Hi Elena — great to hear about the DemoWeek slot, congrats. Mateo, thanks for triaging.

Elena, short answer: we can likely accommodate a partial early release plus a short dedicated window as a one-time exception, provided we capture a few guardrails:
- Early draw: approve up to 40% (USD 4,800) of the mini-grant now. The remaining 60% holds until a short post-demo usage check-in (7 days).
- Dedicated conversion: we can allocate a 48-hour dedicated window for up to a 48 GPU-hours equivalent (billing-equivalent token cap = 100k), but we’ll need a fallback pricing covenant: if usage exceeds the pledged tokens during the 30-day evaluation, normal per-token rates apply.
- Paperwork: we need a signed order form to record the temporary conversion and the fallback covenant; we can use a lightweight addendum.

If that works for you, I’ll draft the addendum and an internal ticket to provision the dedicated slot. One more ask — can you commit to an evaluation report (short, bulleted) within 10 days post-demo confirming the high-level outcomes? That helps us treat future exceptions.

I’ve added a permissive but enforceable clause on overages so finance isn’t exposed. Laura — please confirm the billing path and whether we require a PO vs. DocuSign-only acknowledgement.

Elena — if you approve the high-level terms above, reply-all and we’ll send the doc and DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Quick finance note: we can record a one-time early release against the promo bucket but we need an auditable paper trail. Options:
1) Signed order form (preferred) that references the mini-grant allocation and the temporary dedicated conversion + fallback pricing. This keeps promotions on the correct GL.
2) If Luminary can provide a PO referencing our addendum, that also works.

We cannot transfer promo credits into a billed reserved commitment without an amendment and an approved sales credit memo. For the 48-hour dedicated window, we will provision the capacity after receipt of either (a) signed order form via DocuSign or (b) an email from Luminary confirming acceptance AND a PO number.

I’ll prepare a short OrderForm-Luminary.docx with fields for PO/PO number, the early draw amount (USD 4,800), the dedicated window dates, and the overage fallback rate. Marissa — please confirm the fallback rate you want included in the form; I’ll lock it and send to Mateo for signature routing.
